newsitem.title: INDIA: India July sugar output at 205,000 tonnes - industry.
newsitem.headline: India July sugar output at 205,000 tonnes - industry.

text.p: India produced 205,000 tonnes of sugar in July, compared with 169,000 in the same period last year, the industry said in a statement on Thursday.

Output during the first 10 months of the crop year 1995/96 (Oct-Sept) was 16.27 million tonnes, the Indian Sugar Mills Association and the National Federation of Co-operative Sugar Factories Ltd said in a joint statement.
India produced 14.36 million tonnes of sugar in the first 10 months of 1994/95, the statement said.

Sugar despatches from factories in July was 1.05 million tonnes for domestic consumption and 72,000 tonnes for exports against 1.06 million tonnes for internal consumption and nil for exports in the same period last year, the statement said.

Total offtake in the current season to July was 10.62 million tonnes of domestically manufactured sugar and 200,000 tonnes of imported sugar for internal consumption and 872,000 tonnes for exports, the statement said.
Last year, total offtake to July was 8.95 million tonnes of domestic sugar and about 1.25 million tonnes of imported sugar for domestic consumption and 23,000 tonnes for exports, it said.
Stocks of sugar as on July 31 were 10.18 million tonnes compared with 7.21 million a year earlier, the statement said.
